scope: Assembled NMOS6502 per-store trace plus conservative PAL row-deadline bound; not cycle-exact VIC simulation. Independent PAL scanout verification is separate.

timing.deadline: Start of next row badline, before its first matrix-fetch clock
timing.stallDerivation: 25*(40 matrix-access clocks + up to3 BA/RDY lead-in clocks)

startupKeyScope: Initial key is decoded with DEN off before the traced frame0 no-op. Every later frame0 is the actual63-to0 closing delta.

timingSources.title: Christian Bauer: The MOS6567/6569 video controller, sections2.4.3,3.5,3.6 and3.7
